response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an accomplished full-stack and systems engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile development, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantial recent C++ experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments a decade ago), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure despite one fintech-adjacent role (RIDE Capital) that used Node/TypeScript rather than C++.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering craftsmanship with 15+ years of experience
Some brief historical C/C++ exposure (National Instruments, embedded/robotics work)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No current or recent hands-on C++ development (last significant C++ use ~2015)
No SQL Server or Oracle experience listed; only generic SQL/MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience despite one fintech role using unrelated tech stack

key_factors.factor: No fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
